title: Advance Durable Goods Orders (Oct 2026 data) — pulled forward onto the Wednesday before Thanksgiving
source: EST: census.gov/economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html re-fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 91,396 bytes) and parsed row-by-row across all 179 table rows by this session. The row reads exactly "Advance Report on Durable Goods--Manufacturers' Shipments, Inventories, and Orders | November 25, 2026 | 8:30 AM | October 2026". Primary-sourced, but filed estimate per the event-research lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep — identical treatment to the sibling durable-goods-2026-09-25 / -2026-10-27 / -2026-12-23 entries.
notes: DISCOVERED during the thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05). This calendar tracked the September, October and December releases of this series and had NO November entry. The date itself is the finding: the advance durable-goods report normally lands in the last week of the month, and in 2026 that puts it on the Wednesday BEFORE Thanksgiving rather than after — the same 8:30 a.m. ET slot already carrying pce-2026-11-25 and gdp-q3-2026-second-2026-11-25 (both high impact, both confirmed), with beige-book-2026-11-25 later that day and, per the same Census calendar, New Residential Sales and Preliminary U.S. Imports for Consumption of Steel Products at 10:00 a.m. The consequence recorded in the thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 ledger: this corridor is front-loaded onto a single Wednesday session, then a full NYSE closure (11-26), then a 1:00 p.m. ET half session (11-27), then the FOMC communications blackout opening 11-28 — so a move on Monday 2026-11-30 has at least five competing explanations before it has any one of them. Impact is medium, matching its sibling entries; symbols is empty.
